name: PR acceptance
description:
Shows: Of the factory PRs closed in the last 30 days, the share merged (AVG pr_merged) and the share merged without a revise round (AVG pr_first_pass), per agent. Reads pr.closed.
Why it matters: The quality measure of the factory's output: how much of what it produces is good enough to ship, and how often it gets it right first time. Low first-pass rates mean review cycles and human time.
